name: The NUG
subtitle: Portable block with four edges, jug, and pinch.

strands.provenance: Retained manufacturer front/reverse views show this exposed lead ending at its native entrance well; no hidden connection is asserted. Manufacturer product page specifies 6 mm rated climbing cord (https://frictitiousclimbing.com/products/the-nug), giving a 3 mm radius. The 110 mm visible-lead rest length is a display estimate selected in response to the user requesting a shorter cord; actual supplied cord length and hidden joins remain unknown. Routes and hanging height are generated against the approved native CAD solid.
